text:
mia: Heads-up everyone 11 Snow advisory for SF this morning. The building ops team just told us the loading dock is closed and some nearby lots are limited. If you were planning to come onsite, read options below.

cesar: Thanks Mia. Options?

mia: 1) Work from home today (recommended if you live outside the city), 2) If you must come, use the temporary shuttle (see ops-bot), 3) If you need parking or a rideshare due to unsafe transit, submit receipts (policy below).

ops-bot: shuttle-update: Weather shuttle running 8:30am-11:30am and 3pm-6pm with extra stops at Brannan & 4th and Mission & 2nd. Calendar invites updated.

lina: If I take a rideshare because muni is cancelled, what's reimbursable?

mia: Reimbursement: submit rideshare receipts to Expensify, tag "weather-2026". Cap $40 one-way/$80 round-trip. If you need childcare help for the day, submit up to $60 with the same tag.

facilities: If you drove and need lot validation DM facilities with license plate. Limited spots; we prioritize ADA and families.

cesar: Managers, please be flexible on attendance and timelines. No one should risk travel.

mia: We'll post an update at 12:30pm about afternoon plans. Stay safe.
